findings.one_line: The core makes the Wang comparison precise, but its related-work account gives no relevance/comparison sentence for cited Beresteanu--Molchanov--Molinari (2011), Westling et al. (2024), Andrews--Kitagawa--McCloskey (2024), Liu et al. (2021), or van der Vaart--Wellner (1996); complete the targeted positioning and distinguish why these do not subsume the law-sharp curve result.

This unconsumed sufficient strict-inclusion theorem is superseded by the later exact iff frontier in thm:exact-obstacle-strictness; delete it as a numbered result and retain any useful historical sufficient-condition discussion as prose.

The promised ADJUVANT subgroup-sign reanalysis is not delivered: this theorem supplies only a generic construction and expressly leaves all trial-specific inputs and sign conclusions absent, so the applied deliverable was substituted by a conditional caveat.
